filename: Future Changes in the Annual Sea‐Level Cycle.pdf
title: Future Changes in the Annual Sea‐Level Cycle
authors: Roderik S. W. van de Wal
testbed_rationale: The study does not develop machine learning parameterizations or provide a high-resolution simulation testbed suitable for subgrid-scale scientific ML training.
pain_points: Coarse GCM resolution prevents resolving coastal geometry, bottom topography, tides, and river discharge dynamics driving coastal sea-level cycles.
Substantial projection uncertainty resulting from internal climate variability and inter-model spread.
Four CMIP6 models exhibited particularly poor performance simulating the historical annual cycle and had to be excluded.
extraction_notes: The research was supported in part by the NSF LEAP STC (award 2019625) which provided computing and storage resources, but the study itself does not employ machine learning methods.
